Panjab University Constituent College
Patto Hira Singh, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga)
NO 274 /D/PUCCNSW Corrigendum Dated 04/10/2023
To
The Director Computer Centre,
Panjab University,
Chandigarh-160014.
Subject:- Cancellation of the advertisement of Guest faculty in English vide
advertisement no. 255/Dpuccnsw dated: 26/09/2023.
Dear Sir.
With reference to the subject cited above, it is informed that due to
administrative reasons, the walk-in-interview vide advertisement no.
255/Dpuccnsw dated: 26/09/2023 for the appointment of Guest faculty 0f
English to be held on 05/10/2O23 (Thursday) at Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan, Panjab
University, Chandigarh shall stand Cancelled.
Thanking you.
Sd/-
Principal
PU Constituent College
Nihal Singh Wala (Moga)
